notes: Application permissions are Microsoft Graph app roles granted (with admin consent) to the service principal EARM signs in with (AZURE_CLIENT_ID, or the managed identity). Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy replaces Application.ReadWrite.All for applications the service principal owns.

Edge permissions are listed for every relationship property the template declares (including an empty array, which removes edges). Key Vault access is an Azure RBAC / access-policy requirement of the signed-in identity, not a Graph permission.
